description: This file defines the JSON schema for the RemoteControl API, including data structures, methods, events, and documentation for a plugin that manages remote control pairing, IR programming, and remote data management.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the current version number of the RemoteControl API.

methods.name: getNetStatus
methods.description: Returns status information for a specific network including pairing and IR programming states.

methods.name: startPairing
methods.description: Initiates pairing of a remote control with the STB on a specified network.

methods.name: initializeIRDB
methods.description: Initializes the IR database for a specific network.

methods.name: clearIRCodes
methods.description: Clears IR codes from a specified remote control.

methods.name: setIRCode
methods.description: Programs an IR code into a specified remote control.

methods.name: getIRCodesByAutoLookup
methods.description: Retrieves IR codes for TV and AVR devices based on automatic lookup for a network.

methods.name: getIRCodesByNames
methods.description: Retrieves IR codes for a specific AV device identified by manufacturer and model.

methods.name: getIRDBManufacturers
methods.description: Lists manufacturers of IR devices for a network and device type.

methods.name: getIRDBModels
methods.description: Lists models for a given manufacturer and device type.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Provides details of the last key pressed on the remote control.

methods.name: configureWakeupKeys
methods.description: Configures which keys on the remote will wake the device from deepsleep.

methods.name: findMyRemote
methods.description: Makes the most recently used remote emit a beep sound.

methods.name: factoryReset
methods.description: Resets all paired and connected remotes to factory settings.
